items.prompt: What evidence would you inspect before believing a backtest ledger rather than only its final return?
items.modelAnswer: Event order and historical-only signals; cash/positions/fees/marks/pending state per event; independent cashflow/quantity reconciliation, domain constraints and missing/corporate-action policy; prefix causality and terminal holdings; fill/cost/source assumptions. Final equity and deterministic replay alone do not prove real fills or future performance.
